groups.name: Payload
groups.profile: Emerged early 2026 (tracked since 2026-02-17); Babuk-derived locker for Windows and ESXi, double extortion; claimed 12 victims in seven countries within hours of launching its leak site. Today it posted three German victims within four minutes.

groups.name: Emperador
groups.profile: Leak site tracked since 2026-08-12 with no published tactics profile. Postings include scheduled publication dates and short deadlines.

groups.name: Interlock
groups.profile: First seen September 2024; double extortion against healthcare, government, education and technology in North America and Europe (57+ claimed victims, including a major US dialysis provider). Known for fake browser-update / ClickFix lures. Today: two school postings at the same minute.

groups.name: Vexy
groups.profile: Tracked by Ransomware.live since 2026-09-03 as "Vexy Ransomware" (RansomLook: "vexy"); no published tactics profile.

groups.name: AuditTeam
groups.profile: Small group tracked since 2026-04-08 (~5 known victims), mainly technology and manufacturing in East and Southeast Asia; runs a double-extortion leak site. Posted five "AUDIT ENTITY" entries today; four are masked and excluded.

groups.name: INC Ransom
groups.profile: RaaS active since July 2023; one of the most prolific leak sites (200+ victims in 2025), hitting healthcare, government, education and manufacturing in North America and Europe. Affiliates have exploited edge devices and used spear-phishing.

groups.name: Qilin
groups.profile: Also known as Agenda. Golang/Rust RaaS active since July 2022 and one of the most prolific leak sites of 2025–26; double extortion, with the operator controlling encryption modes. A quiet day after 11 postings in №69.

groups.name: Rhysida
groups.profile: RaaS since May 2023; phishing and Cobalt Strike for access; sells stolen data in auction-style lots. Today's posting has a detailed inventory, including special-education records of minors.

groups.name: Sarcoma
groups.profile: Debuted October 2024 and quickly ranked among the most active groups (116+ victims by mid-2025); targets mid-market manufacturing, retail, healthcare, legal and business services, with about half of its victims in the US.
